mapper.sql: id, code, dictionary_id, national_code, standard_name, standard_unit, report_type, comparability_note, dictionary_version, sort_order
mapper.select: SELECT FROM metric_definition ORDER BY sort_order, id
mapper.sql: FROM observation o JOIN report r ON r.id = o.report_id WHERE r.profile_id = #{profileId} AND r.visibility_status = 'NORMAL' AND r.processing_status = 'CONFIRMED' AND o.status = 'FORMAL' AND o.examination_date IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS observation_id, o.report_id, d.code AS metric_code, o.examination_date, o.original_value, o.result_kind, o.numeric_value, o.unit_text, o.reference_text, o.reference_low, o.reference_high, o.abnormal_flag, o.specimen_text, o.method_text FROM observation o JOIN report r ON r.id = o.report_id JOIN metric_definition d ON d.id = o.metric_definition_id WHERE r.profile_id = #{profileId} AND r.visibility_status = 'NORMAL' AND r.processing_status = 'CONFIRMED' AND o.status = 'FORMAL' AND o.examination_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.sort_order, o.examination_date, o.id
